name: ctor-lab
description: Hand-authored fixture for constructor objects (§4.4): the `interface` + `declare const` spelling, `typeof X` at a member position, an interface of construct signatures only, and the negatives - a class nothing typeofs, and `typeof` over a plain value. Tracked in git, no npm install, so the goldens pin the mapping under the live compiler and the run gate proves EmitConstructor on an abstract member actually news.
